highlights.en: Built the backend of a football match organization platform as 5 independent Spring Boot services: API Gateway, Identity, Match, Communication, and Notification. Each service has its own PostgreSQL database, and schema changes are managed with Flyway.
highlights.tr: Futbol maçı organizasyon platformunun backend'ini, API Gateway, Identity, Match, Communication ve Notification olmak üzere 5 bağımsız Spring Boot servisine ayırarak mikroservis mimarisinde geliştirdim. Her servisin kendi PostgreSQL veritabanı var, şema değişiklikleri Flyway ile yönetiliyor.

highlights.en: Implemented inter-service communication largely through Kafka events (more than 20 topics); notifications are created when the Notification Service consumes these events.
highlights.tr: Servisler arası iletişimi büyük ölçüde Kafka event'leriyle kurdum (20'den fazla topic); bildirimler Notification Service'in bu event'leri dinlemesiyle oluşuyor.

highlights.en: Each service verifies JWTs with its own RSA public key; the API Gateway provides Redis-backed rate limiting with Bucket4j and a Resilience4j circuit breaker.
highlights.tr: Her servis JWT'yi kendi RSA public key'iyle doğruluyor; API Gateway'de Bucket4j ile Redis tabanlı rate limiting ve Resilience4j circuit breaker var.

highlights.en: CI/CD builds only changed services, pushes them to GHCR tagged with the Git SHA, and deploys to AWS EC2 without SSH via SSM Run Command, with automatic rollback on a failed health check.
highlights.tr: CI/CD yalnızca değişen servisleri build edip Git SHA etiketiyle GHCR'a gönderiyor, SSH kullanmadan SSM Run Command ile AWS EC2'ye deploy ediyor; health check başarısız olursa otomatik rollback yapılıyor.

highlights.en: GitHub Actions pipeline covering test, release, build, and deployment for a Python/FastAPI backend and a TypeScript frontend; with dorny/paths-filter and a dynamic build matrix, only changed services are tested and built.
highlights.tr: Python/FastAPI backend ve TypeScript frontend için test, release, build ve deployment süreçlerini kapsayan GitHub Actions pipeline'ı; dorny/paths-filter ve dinamik build matrisi sayesinde yalnızca değişen servisler test ediliyor ve build ediliyor.

highlights.en: Deploys to AWS EC2 without SSH using SSM Run Command; a temporary IAM role is obtained via OIDC, so CI holds no static AWS keys.
highlights.tr: SSH kullanmadan SSM Run Command ile AWS EC2'ye deploy; OIDC ile geçici IAM role alınıyor, CI'da sabit AWS anahtarı yok.

highlights.en: Docker Compose with health checks, startup ordering, and resource limits; release-please generates versions and changelogs from Conventional Commits.
highlights.tr: Docker Compose ile health check, başlatma sırası ve kaynak limitleri; release-please Conventional Commits'ten versiyon ve changelog üretiyor.

summary.en: Distributed transactions across a 5-service commerce backend
summary.tr: 5 servisli bir commerce backend'inde distributed transaction'lar

highlights.en: Five services (user, product, order, inventory, payment); RabbitMQ for asynchronous stock and payment processing, the Saga pattern with compensating transactions for consistency, and row-level locking for concurrent stock updates.
highlights.tr: User, product, order, inventory ve payment olmak üzere 5 servis; RabbitMQ üzerinden asynchronous stock ve payment işlemleri, tutarlılık için Saga pattern ve compensating transactions, concurrent stock güncellemeleri için row-level locking.

highlights.en: Nginx API Gateway for routing, rate limiting, and JWT authentication; services are isolated with a database-per-service design.
highlights.tr: Nginx API Gateway ile servis yönlendirme, rate limiting ve JWT authentication; servisler database-per-service olarak izole.

summary.en: Polyglot persistence and an API gateway

highlights.en: Four Spring Boot services (gateway, product, inventory, order); MongoDB for products and MySQL for inventory and order, with routing, CORS, and OAuth2 centralized in Spring Cloud Gateway.
highlights.tr: Gateway, product, inventory ve order servislerinden oluşan 4 servisli Spring Boot sistemi; ürünler için MongoDB, inventory ve order için MySQL (polyglot persistence), routing, CORS ve OAuth2 Spring Cloud Gateway üzerinde toplandı.

highlights.en: Integration tests with Testcontainers + RestAssured against real MySQL and MongoDB instances; OpenAPI documentation and a Next.js + TailwindCSS frontend that works through the gateway.
highlights.tr: Gerçek MySQL ve MongoDB instance'larına karşı Testcontainers + RestAssured ile integration test; OpenAPI dokümantasyonu ve gateway üzerinden çalışan Next.js + TailwindCSS frontend.
